firstPlayerRule: Each player rolls one of the dice numbered 5 to 10. The highest roll plays first, and so on down to the lowest roll, who plays last.
houseFallback: If players tie, those players roll again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Mattel service-site instruction PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "PLAY: To see who plays first, each player rolls one of the dice numbered 5 to 10. The player with the highest roll plays first, and so on, down to the player with the lowest roll, who plays last." © 2011 Mattel.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal rolls.
